verdict.rationale: Stripe Radar exposes a documented public REST API (review approve/decline, value lists, early fraud warnings) and Stripe's docs are AI-consumable via llms.txt/markdown docs, plus an official MCP server and CLI exist for programmatic/agentic access. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s) and independent hands-on confirmation of AI agents driving Radar specifically via the API.
